package.author: George M. Howard
package.description: top for git -- every repo and worktree on the box, most actionable first

en-US.author: George M. Howard
en-US.description: top for git -- every repo and worktree on the box, most actionable first
en-US.longDescription: A single-file, no-dependency TUI that scans every git repo and worktree on the box and orders them by what it costs to ignore -- mid-operation, diverged, uncommitted, then quiet. Watch mode takes keys; --once / pipes stay scriptable.
en-US.name: git-roost
en-US.releaseNotes:
0.10.0 (2026-09-05)

Added
- Unicode glyph dialect for watch mode, and a steady live repaint during a resize drag (#57) (d014aa7)
